rules.sentence: A notable feature of muscular dystrophy is the tendency to adopt a prone position before standing, which persists beyond 3 years.[1]
The valley sign, due to hypertrophic infraspinatus and atrophy of the deltoid with axillary fold, can also help confirm the diagnosis.[3]
Earlier diagnosis facilitates prompt physical therapy and support management as well as genetic counseling.[2]
The most important aspect is to rule out treatable conditions, such as discitis, that can also mimic Gowers' sign.
